_comment: The course plan: the course description, which module each week belongs to and its focus area. Read by frontend-a, frontend-b and frontend-c for the course index. A week's days (its key topics) come from course-index.json, so a week listed here with no built days shows as 'opens soon'. Edit freely; the index updates on save.
description: Learn to automate web testing with Playwright and TypeScript. Set up your tools, learn just enough TypeScript, then write, run and debug real tests — building up to a maintainable test framework and a real-world project that runs in CI.
